opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Certiorari denied. Mr. Justice Brennan and Mr. Justice Stewart are of the opinion that cer-tiorari should be granted, the judgment vacated, and the case remanded for further consideration in light of Peyton v. Rowe, 391 U. S. 54.
